measurement: Order the liner kit in the same size as the Rebound DUAL OTS brace already in use, XS to 3XL. Brace sizing is based on thigh circumference measured 6 in. (15 cm) above mid patella, ranging from 15 to 30 in. (38.1 to 76 cm) across the size range. No new measurement is required to order a replacement liner kit. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee .
